description: UK POS/EPOS SaaS pilot — modular monolith (TypeScript/NestJS + PostgreSQL + Kysely). Build-02: core backend modules (admin, catalogue, inventory, sales) on PGlite-backed PostgreSQL.
name: uk-pos-pilot

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @uk-pos/shared-kernel build && pnpm --filter @uk-pos/db build && pnpm --filter @uk-pos/api build && pnpm --filter @uk-pos/register-app build && pnpm --filter @uk-pos/admin-web build
scripts.build:api: pnpm --filter @uk-pos/shared-kernel build && pnpm --filter @uk-pos/db build && pnpm --filter @uk-pos/api build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @uk-pos/shared-kernel test && pnpm --filter @uk-pos/db test && pnpm --filter @uk-pos/api test && pnpm --filter @uk-pos/register-app test && pnpm --filter @uk-pos/admin-web test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @uk-pos/shared-kernel typecheck && pnpm --filter @uk-pos/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @uk-pos/db typecheck && pnpm --filter @uk-pos/register-app typecheck && pnpm --filter @uk-pos/admin-web typecheck
